Hard.description: Canonical dict always sorted; confidence rounded 6dp; no float ambiguity.
HMAC-SHA256 links each explanation to its predecessor; broken chain raises immediately.
Explanations are append-only; second explain() for same mutation_id is idempotent.
Explainer restricted to mutation proposal verdicts; never reads CEL or agent memory.
Every mutation verdict MUST produce a persisted explanation before the call returns.
